title: Orell's & Kasama Labels
summary: Wrap-around labels for Premium Banana Thins, Sweet & Spicy Chili Jam and Chili Garlic Paste.
description: Wrap-around labels for products distributed by RGH Corporation: Orell's Premium Banana Thins, built around a friendly banana mascot, plus KASAMA Cooperatives' Sweet & Spicy Chili Jam and Honest Farm Chili Garlic Paste.
Each label carries full nutrition panels, barcodes and regulatory text laid out to print-ready specifications.
